identity.N1_provenance: Previous directed-audit hand proof and supervisor-informed manual check; no new independent-review attribution

overall.summary_zh: 有限预算内选择首个可逆token的策略在原FI游戏中合法。逐历史的秩界和选择后的fresh联合视图归约均成立；fresh只需mbar个行混合，k计入运行预算。原游戏概率差为p_k-beta_k，并得到明确的接近最大优势下界。当前声明的理想模型内未出现新的关键数学缺口。

target.original_game: rand-ind-eu-cpa, real fresh versus real update
normalizations: KG uses the same single global Setup parameters

legality.epoch_budget_convention: Epochs0,...,T, hence at most T Next calls and T+1 epochs; if E total epochs is given, use T=E-1
legality.attempt_cap: 1<=k<=T, with k allowed Enc/Next/Corr calls and total budget Q>=3k+1
per_attempt: Enc at epoch j-1 to obtain a registered ordinary parent
legality.success_action: Use that just-generated ordinary parent in the sole Challenge at epoch J, then perform support test and terminate
legality.all_failed_action: Fresh independent fair bit, no Challenge needed by printed original terminal rule
legality.exactly_one_challenge_variant: On all failures, issue a final valid but ignored Challenge and output a fair bit; same advantage and3k+1 upper bound

definitions.S: At least one invertible token found by attempt k
definitions.J: First successful position, infinity on all failures

stopping_time.conditional_hazard_identity: p_k=1-product_(j=1)^k(1-a_bar_j), a_bar_j=Pr[E_j | previous failures] whenever that failure prefix has positive probability
stopping_time.history_lower_bound: If Pr[E_j | full visible pre-token history]>=a_* for every reached history, p_k>=1-(1-a_*)^k
stopping_time.why_history_bound_holds_in_ideal_subdoma: F2_j is freshly sampled independently of the entire past and all other current coins; after fixing A,U2_j and private state, P2_j is a fixed translate of F2_j. Tower conditioning preserves direct rank bounds.
stopping_time.marginal_only_counterexample: Reusing one P2 every round preserves each marginal invertibility rate but gives p_k=alpha for every k; subsequent conditional hazard after one failure is0. This is outside the independent-TG ideal model.

original_game_probabilities.beta_k: Pr[S and selected support check passes in real fresh world]

selected_view_reduction.assumption: Specified normal-form decisional LWE: same uniform public A in Zq^(n*n), independent small-secret u and small-error f from chi^n, v=uA+f versus uniform row
selected_view_reduction.context: Full real prechallenge history generated using the input A, including every ordinary parent, token, key relationships and registration state
selected_view_reduction.selection_order: Compute S and J without reading the supplied fresh LWE row v
selected_view_reduction.embedding: Only in the unique selected challenge; mbar row hybrids
selected_view_reduction.S_false: Reduction outputs0 for the joint event and leaves v unused
selected_view_reduction.omitted_field: Selected fresh challenge second block; fixed attack uses it in neither selection nor output
selected_view_reduction.full_parent_second_blocks: Honestly generatable and included for registration consistency
selected_view_reduction.k_cost: Simulation time, generated data, rank checks and the concrete distinguisher budget grow with k
selected_view_reduction.context_real_row_count: At most k*(nD+n+mbar), plus at most mbar-1 self-generated selected-challenge rows
selected_view_reduction.runtime_ring_bound: O(k*((D+1)*n^2*(n+nbar)+mbar*n*(n+nbar)+n^2*nbar)+n^3+mbar*n^2*D), plus sampling, k mod2 rank checks, I/O and D-bit arithmetic

optional_general_chi_rank_reduction.assumptions: Ideal independent chi TG sampling with shared uniform A and the specified row nf-DLWE assumption
optional_general_chi_rank_reduction.event: At least one of k potential P2 matrices is invertible

theorem.bias: One half of the applicable FI probability-gap bound
theorem.success: One half plus one half of the applicable ideal-model gap bound
theorem.failure: At most one half minus one half of the applicable ideal-model gap bound
theorem.k1: Recovers the previous fixed-token attack and exact alpha-beta identity
theorem.ideal_actual_gap_monotonicity: For fixed parameters and a common sufficiently large budget, Delta_k=sum_j<=k Pr[J=j]*(1-r_j), so it is nondecreasing with k
theorem.numerical_bound_caveat: epsilon_ct(k) has a larger time budget as k grows; compare all terms, not only the search factor

asymptotics.PPT_requirement: k,n,D,mbar,nbar and sampling costs polynomial in lambda; cap k fixed before execution
asymptotics.example: k=ceil((log(lambda))^2) if the allowed T accommodates it
asymptotics.fixed_C_log_lambda: Gives a specified inverse-polynomial error, generally not a negligible error for one fixed C
asymptotics.near_maximum_gap: If theta, epsilon_ct(k), any epsilon_P(k), and any implementation/generator losses are negligible, the gap tends to1 with negligible deficit under the search-failure condition
asymptotics.finite_T: Amplification is capped by actual allowed Next and query budgets

concrete_formula_table.scope: Formula values for ideal rank-search models; not measured cryptographic success rates

implementation_losses.model: nu_b(k) bounds each b branch's output1 probability change from the proved model, including adaptive stopping
implementation_losses.decomposition: nu_b <= nu_A_b + nu_rng_b + nu_fail_b when corresponding hybrid/coupling arguments are established
implementation_losses.success_orientation_caveat: For arbitrary faults, the fixed-orientation success lower bound uses the signed untruncated margin; fair-coin fallback can supply the trivial1/2 guarantee when a known margin is nonpositive
implementation_losses.seedA_consistency: Keep (seedA,Gen(seedA)) consistent; alternatively prove the retained adaptive view is samplable from A alone before using a marginal generator comparison
implementation_losses.secret_seed_reuse: Needs separate joint-distribution analysis; can invalidate history hazards or the selection-before-fresh-row simulation

correctness.why: Each round creates a new ordinary parent at its current epoch; no challenge exists during failed-trial Next calls
correctness.whole_scheme_guarantee: For any promised longer chain use its actual t_max, potentially up to T
correctness.joint_parameter_statement: Correctness and attack applicability can be stated together by adding the sufficient correctness condition to the theorem assumptions; the required hardness assumption and finite epsilon values remain explicit

research_exit.method_novelty: Classical stopping/selection amplification and row hybrids; direct parameterized corollary, no new generic method claimed
intrinsic_assumptions_retained: Ideal independence or proved generator replacement
actual_benchmark_remaining: A sharing and public seed use
research_exit.priority_remaining: Global prior-art coverage and predecessor version/source verification; no global-first claim

scope_boundaries.attacked_property: FI real fresh/update origin indistinguishability, including equal messages
scope_boundaries.LWE: Used as explicit distributional hardness assumption; no solving algorithm claimed
scope_boundaries.new_protection_or_resource_advantage: None claimed; implementation gate remains closed

action_counts.mathematical_check_scope: CDF-derived scalar products and finite stopping-time probability enumeration only
